meta.templateNote: Webhook-triggered by application/automation/send-weekly-report.ts's postWeeklyReport(), called once per recipient from the /api/trigger/weekly-report route (self-throttled to once/7 days by automation_settings.weeklyReportLastSentAt). App computes the numbers server-side (getLeadStats/getLeadTrend/getRevenueSummary/getConversionFunnel/getTopUncontactedLeads, unchanged); this workflow owns rendering (HTML/text/subject) and sending (Resend). Requires the same AVERONAI_NOTIFY_SHARED_SECRET and N8N_WEEKLY_REPORT_WEBHOOK_URL as workflow 08, plus a Resend API Bearer credential and AVERONAI_NOTIFY_FROM_EMAIL env var.
